content:
Apple TV is currently airing multiple new shows with a stellar lineup, and more new titles are set to join soon. The British comedy "Small Prophets" will premiere next week, having achieved a perfect 100% rating on the review site Rotten Tomatoes. Here's a trailer for everyone.

"Small Prophets" will premiere on Apple TV on October 7, and has already been well-received by audiences and critics before its debut.

Last month, Apple TV announced a rather unusual arrangement: acquiring the broadcasting rights to an existing series from another television network.

The British comedy "Small Prophets" previously premiered in the UK, quickly becoming a ratings guarantee for BBC and earning a perfect 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Apple will bring this highly acclaimed series to global audiences.

"Small Prophets" will premiere its first two episodes on Apple TV on October 7 (Wednesday), followed by weekly releases until the series concludes on November 4.

Apple released a trailer for "Small Prophets" today for an early look. Here's a synopsis of the series, followed by the trailer:

"Small Prophets" is created, written, and directed by Mackenzie Crook, who is also the creator of "Detectorists" and has appeared in "The Office" (UK version) and the "Pirates of the Caribbean" series.

Note: "Small Prophets" will be available globally on Apple TV simultaneously, but UK viewers will have to wait until 2027 to watch it.

Other comedies currently airing on Apple TV include "Brothers" starring Matthew McConaughey, and the fourth season of "Ted Lasso". The popular series "Stick" starring Owen Wilson is also set to return soon.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, with discount offers available through the Apple One bundle subscription.
